notes: Convenience-store chain of Grupo Lindcorp ('Tambo+' brand; Wikidata alias 'Tiendas Tambo S.A.C.'). Default OFF per project config. Store count: Peru Retail 2026-09-09, 'supera las 900 tiendas a nivel nacional' (902). The official locator page tambo.pe/locales (Justo ordering platform) listed 787 stores on 2026-10-01 (lima.PE 687, chiclayo.PE 44, ica.PE 26, arequipa.PE 21, piura.PE 9) — fewer than reported, probably only stores enabled for pickup/ordering; raw snapshot with coordinates in tools/seed/raw/tambo-locator-2026-10-01.json. Colours: magenta #A51890 (vector web logo; avatar background renders #C21195), yellow #FFE202. OSM (probe 2026-10-01): 87 features brand=Tambo+ / brand:wikidata=Q64516439 (NSI), ~55 more named 'Tambo'/'Tambo+'/'TAMBO' (shop=convenience mostly, a few supermarket/yes/variety_store). FALSE POSITIVES to avoid: 'Tambo' is a common Quechua place word — government 'Tambo <village>' centres (amenity=social_facility, PAIS programme), villages/districts (Tambo, Tambogrande, Tambopata, Ollantaytambo…), restaurants 'El Tambo', 'Tambo del Inca', 'Tambo pesquero…' (seafood), 'Tambo - Licorería…' (alcohol). The regex needs the name to start with 'Tambo' as a word (optional +/plus), rejects 'Tambo de…/del…', and the shop list excludes amenity/seafood/alcohol features.
